title: How AI models and agents work together
status: Prepared production source; animation not rendered

scenes.headline: How AI models and agents work together
scenes.narration: Using several AI models together sounds powerful. But reliable collaboration starts with understanding which part of the system does what.

captions.text: Using several AI models together sounds powerful.
But reliable collaboration starts with understanding
which part of the system does what.

scenes.headline: Know which component does what
scenes.narration: A model generates responses. A harness manages the agent's tools and context. An orchestrator coordinates the workflow. The interface is where you interact. A sandbox limits what execution can access.

captions.text: A model generates responses.
A harness manages the agent's tools and context.
An orchestrator coordinates the workflow.
The interface is where you interact.
A sandbox limits what execution can access.

scenes.headline: One task and a repair loop
scenes.narration: Imagine adding CSV export to an app. Agree on the requirements, then let an agent implement them. Run tests, ask a separate reviewer to find concrete defects, and send failures back for repair.

captions.text: Imagine adding CSV export to an app.
Agree on the requirements, then let an agent implement them.
Run tests, ask a separate reviewer to find concrete defects,
and send failures back for repair.

scenes.headline: Evidence supports acceptance
scenes.narration: After repairs, a fresh verifier checks the candidate against each original requirement. For example: does the export respect the selected filter? Record the evidence. Agreement alone does not establish correctness.

scenes.headline: Choose the level to reuse
scenes.narration: LangGraph provides workflow building blocks. Deep Agents adds a reusable harness. Deep Agents Code supplies a terminal application. An existing interface can connect through an integration.

captions.text: LangGraph provides workflow building blocks.

scenes.headline: Start small and inspect the evidence
scenes.narration: Start with one bounded task, clear stopping rules, and checks you can inspect. Compare with a single agent. Add complexity when it earns its place.
